text.p: Firstar Corp said Thursday it will split its stock two-for-one, and will repurchase 12 million shares, on a post-split basis, by the end of 1997.
The stock split will be distributed February 15 to shareholders of record January 27, the $19.8 billion asset bank holding company said.
The new repurchase program replaces a smaller program announced late last year, Firstar said.
The program will be funded in part by the private sale of $150 million in trust preferred stock completed in December, the company said.
The new repurchase program will retire about eight percent of the company's common shares outstanding, Firstar said.
Firstar shares were down 1/8 at 55-1/2 Thursday.
